chapter: Other drummers and New Orleans musicians
title: Wrapping up: family and 1930s with Kid Howard
summary: He says only his father and son played; in the 1930s he mostly worked with Kid Howard, never theaters.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I'm about to run out of questions, Bill. Yeah, I can't think of many more. Did you cover all the different bands you played with? Yes. Yeah, we covered all that. We did. All about your family? Were there any other members of your family that played?
No, outside of me, my father and my son.
Oh, say back during the 30's after you got with Kid Howard, did you play many spots with other bands?

No, mostly I was with Kid Howard. Well, where did you play with Kid Howard? I played rhythm club, I played the signing, signings club, I played picnics, weddings and different things, so on and so forth. So down to Grand Island. Never played theater? No, I never played theater in my life.
